description: Operations declared by a stack, or by an Operator installed on its own.

approval.description:
Approval rule per operation: an operation name, or `*` for all of them.
Operations no rule matches need approval.

oneOf.description: Run without approval, or require it.

maxRisk.description:

access request for these operations may cover.

settings.description: Values for the settings the plugin's manifest declares.

oneOf.description: The value of a stack input.
